_purpose: Question set for scripts/llm_citation_probe.py. Questions are what a buyer would ask; they never name a site, so a citation is earned. Keep the private copy of this file in the private companion repo.

_engines: anthropic: Claude through the Messages API with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; exposes the retrieved list and the citations. openrouter: every model in openrouter_models, each with its provider's native search, billed to OPENROUTER_API_KEY; citations only. These are the API models, not the consumer apps; label them that way in any write-up.
